extracted.name: Hearty Chicken and Noodle Casserole
extracted.description: This hearty chicken and noodle casserole recipe features tender chicken, mixed vegetables, noodles, condensed cream of mushroom soup, and lots of cheese.
ingredient_lines: 2 cups medium egg noodles, cooked and drained
1 (10.75 ounce) can Campbell's® Condensed Cream of Mushroom Soup (Regular, 98% Fat Free or 25% Less Sodium)
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
Combine chicken, noodles, soup, vegetables, milk, Parmesan cheese, and black pepper in a 1 ½-quart casserole dish.
Bake in the preheated oven until hot, about 25 minutes. Stir; top with Cheddar cheese.
